Name: Earthy Pets Enhanced UI
Author: AdaDisaster
Description:
[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]1. Make sure you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24026]Pets Enchanced[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13658]Earthy Interface[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] installed.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]2. Download my mod and extract the [CP] EarthyPetsEnhancedUI folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]3. Make sure to check the mod as enabled in the Stardrop, if you run the game using it.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]3. Find the mod (Earthy Pets Enhanced UI) in the Mod Config Menu and choose the color option you want to use. Default is Original Red.[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Using Generic Mod Config Menu (or by editing the config.json file) you can choose the coloring of some UI elements to match the accent colors of Earthy Interface (Slate, Maroon, Plum, Sienna, Olive, Forest, Emerald, Navy, Cornflower, Eggplant, Scarlet, Coal), or leave the original red of Pets Enhanced.[/color]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Thank you [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/61079406]DaisyNiko[/url] for the original Earthy Interface. It makes my game look really pretty!
Thank you [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/198783083]SunkenLace[/url] for the Pets Enhanced mod. My farmer has never been this happy with her pets.
Thank you  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/1552317]Pathoschild[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/34250790]spacechase0[/url] for Content Patcher and GMCM respectively, as well as the people running the official Stardew wiki. I've only started modding and so far, thanks to your work, it's going much more smoother than I feared.[/color]
